title: Brazilian Rose Cake
description: A moist and fragrant cake infused with the flavors of Brazil and the beauty of rose petals.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and grease two 8-inch round cake pans.
In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and confectioners' sugar.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together softened butter, eggs, rose petal jam, aromatic rose syrup, and vanilla extract.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until well combined.
Divide the batter evenly between the prepared pans and smooth the tops.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Allow the cakes to cool in the pans for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
Once the cakes are cool, place one layer on a serving plate and top with the other layer.
Dust the top of the cake with confectioners' sugar and garnish with fresh rose petals.
